description: This Dart source file is the main entry point for a Flutter application that loads and displays local HTML assets within a WebView, including route handling, asset management, and injected web content preparation.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up MaterialApp, route handling, and asset mapping.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: A widget displaying a list of navigable screen tiles including diagnostics.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: A scaffold wrapping a WebView to display a local HTML asset.

classes.name: _WebViewContainer
classes.description: Stateful widget managing WebView build process.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: Widget that loads and displays an HTML asset in a WebView, handling inline CSS/JS, base href injections, and error fallbacks.

classes.name: DiagnosticsScreen
classes.description: Screen that scans referenced assets in HTML for debugging purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Flutter bindings and runs the app.

methods.name: loadHtml
methods.description: Loads and processes the HTML asset, injecting base href, inlining CSS/JS, and preparing data URL for WebView.

methods.name: _injectBaseHrefAndRewrite
methods.description: Injects base href tag and rewrites relative links in HTML content.

methods.name: _ensureViewportMeta
methods.description: Ensures viewport meta tag exists for mobile scaling.

methods.name: _inlineCssIntoHead
methods.description: Inlines CSS content into HTML head.

methods.name: _rewriteCssUrls
methods.description: Rewrites URLs inside CSS to absolute paths.

methods.name: _removeExternalScriptReference
methods.description: Removes external script tags referencing paired JS files.

methods.name: _inlineJsIntoBody
methods.description: Inlines JavaScript content before closing body tag.

methods.name: _pairedCssPath
methods.description: Determines paired CSS filename for an HTML asset.

methods.name: _pairedJsPath
methods.description: Determines paired JS filename for an HTML asset.

methods.name: _fallbackErrorHtml
methods.description: Generates fallback HTML content when asset loading fails.

methods.name: _escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes string for safe inclusion in HTML content.

methods.name: _runChecks
methods.description: Performs asset existence checks for referenced resources used in diagnostics.
